name: Qiaomu X Article Publisher
headline: Qiaomu X Article Publisher - Automate X Article
short_description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles with one click. Ideal for content creators and operations teams. Integrates with Claude Code Skill for persistent authentication and standalone operation. Works on macOS with Python 3.9+.
author: joeseesun

sections.overview:
Qiaomu X Article Publisher automates publishing Markdown articles directly to X (Twitter) Articles, eliminating the need to use X's web editor. It converts Markdown formatting—including headings, bold, italic, lists, quotes, links, and images—into X Articles format and uploads images automatically. The skill features 7-day persistent authentication so you don't need to log in repeatedly, and saves articles as drafts rather than auto-publishing for safety. It works standalone or integrates seamlessly with Claude Code, letting you write and publish articles without leaving your editor.
Content creators publishing long-form articles from local Markdown files to X
Operations teams automating article distribution with version control via Git
Claude Code users publishing articles generated during code assistant conversations
Writers managing article drafts locally while syncing to X Articles platform
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-x-article-publisher`
sections.usage:
```
Publish the following Markdown article to X (Twitter) Articles as a [TITLE]. Use the filename [FILENAME.md] and include the following frontmatter: title: [TITLE], description: [SHORT_DESCRIPTION], tags: [COMMA_SEPARATED_TAGS]. Format the article with proper Markdown syntax and ensure the first paragraph is a compelling hook. [ARTICLE_MARKDOWN]
```
Copy

```
📢 **Published to X Articles!**

**Title:** The Future of AI-Powered Content Creation
**URL:** https://x.com/i/articles/1234567890
**Stats:** 1,247 views | 47 likes | 12 bookmarks

**Content Preview:**
The rise of generative AI isn’t just changing *what* we create—it’s revolutionizing *how* we distribute content. In 2024, platforms like X Articles are becoming the new battleground for thought leadership, where a single well-structured post can reach 10x more readers than a traditional blog. But here’s the catch: most creators are still treating these platforms like blogs, not social networks. The difference? **Hooks in the first 2 lines.**

**Key Insights:**
1. **Algorithm-Friendly Structure:** X Articles prioritizes posts with clear sections (H2/H3 headers) and bullet points. My draft used 3 H2 headers and 5 bullet lists—resulting in 2x the average engagement.
2. **Metadata Matters:** The frontmatter tags ("AI", "Content Strategy", "Twitter") matched trending topics, pushing the post into the "For You" feed for 3 hours longer than usual.
3. **Visual Breaks:** Added a horizontal rule (---) after the hook and before the conclusion. Readers spent 40% more time scrolling vs. my previous posts without it.

**Next Steps:**
- Share the link in your newsletter with a CTA like: "Want the full template? Reply with ‘TEMPLATE’ and I’ll send it."
- Schedule a follow-up thread in 48 hours teasing a case study (e.g., "How this post got 5K views in 3 days—here’s the breakdown").

**Full Article:** [See attached file or visit the link above]

*Tip: To maximize reach, pin this article to your profile and add it to your Linktree!*
```
